# Regression fixtures

- `binjiang-map.json`: anonymous OSM-derived neighborhood geometry retained for building identity, courtyard and water regressions. Names, aliases, descriptive POI fields, addresses, former application markers and unrelated lookup metadata and road material/width attributes have been removed. Attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; see its `source` field.
- `map-seam.json`: a small OSM-derived geometry case used to reproduce a polygon seam issue. Attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL, recorded in the file.

These are source fixtures required by the automated tests. Runtime caches, browser screenshots, recordings and previous test reports are not part of this directory.
